answer: An identity bond that decays like a relic in a meadow stops bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a 40 POA bond; each epoch it sheds 2 POA unless the agent does verified honest work, while a willow bending with real activity keeps its bond whole. A farmer with 100 fakes locks 4,000 POA and bleeds 200 POA per epoch, against a pool near 900 POA. An honest agent pays once and after 20 honest epochs reclaims the full bond plus an undiluted share.
